notes: Afghanistan has no VAT; Business Receipts Tax applies to traders but no gold-specific rate was verifiable, so VAT fields are null. Import duty from the MoF Customs Tariff 2010-1390: gold unwrought HS 7108.12 at 1% (semi-manufactured 2.5%, monetary 5%); silver unwrought HS 7106.91 at 2.5%; jewellery HS 7113 at 10%. The tariff book is old (2010); no newer tariff text could be opened.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance, General Directorate of Customs - Customs Tariff 2010-1390 (copy hosted on acci.org.af)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: Chapter 71 tariff lines - 7108.1200 other unwrought gold 1%, 7106.9100 unwrought silver 2.5%, 7113.1900 gold jewellery 10%.
